instruction: The woman carries leafy wooden staves with glowing tips in two separate groups: a left group of four staves behind her head and a right group of four staves over her shoulder. Add exactly ONE more identical staff to the left group, at its left side, making five there, and exactly ONE more identical staff to the right group, at its right side, making five there. Each new staff has its own clearly separate glowing tip. Do not change the eight staves already there, and keep the brightness and colour of the whole painting the same. The finished painting shows exactly ten staves: five in the left group and five in the right group.
